== Biography ==
'''John Glasgow''' was baptised at Irvine, Ayrshire, on 27 June 1721, the son of [[Glasgow-1077|John Glasgow MA]] and [[Ferguson-15168|Agnes Ferguson]].<ref>Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', Irvine, Ayrshire, Old Parish Registers; indexed christening of John Glasgow, 27 June 1721, son of Agnes Ferguson.</ref>

His sister [[Glasgow-4122|Sarah Glasgow]] was baptised at Irvine in 1726 to the same parents.
